turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you comfortable with how I am speaking?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Please talk a bit slower, my hearing is poor.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I drove her over, I will listen along.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I came because of my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How would you describe what you feel in your chest?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it move into your arms or up toward your neck?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I feel it in my jaw sometimes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Did it begin suddenly or slowly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It came on slowly last night.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, when I carry the laundry.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything ease the pain when it is there?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I took an antacid and it did not do anything.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you felt faint or dizzy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I almost passed out in the kitchen.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you drenched or clammy during the episodes?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little sweaty, yes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is your breathing affected?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little bit, yes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has a parent or sibling had a heart attack?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nobody that I remember.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any history of diabetes, blood pressure problems or cholesterol problems, or do you smoke?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have a history of heart surgery or stents?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: They put a small tube in my heart artery some years back.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Which pills do you take regularly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Clopidogrel and Lisinopril.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: To finish, here is the plan. First, see the heart specialist within two weeks. Second, come back to this clinic in one week. To be sure I was clear, what will you do next?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will see the heart specialist in two weeks and come back here in a week.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I will remind her.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Anything else on your mind?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: All right, we are done. Take care of yourself.
